style.description: Style Atlas daily pick: contemporary editorial translation of woven geometric rhythm, indigo, ochre, terracotta and cream, without copying sacred motifs or a specific living artist.

zh.headlineFact: 关税、AI、气候与文化活动共同进入执行窗口
zh.headlineView: 世界正在检验规则与承载力
zh.intro: 欧盟小包裹关税、AI透明义务、单人创业、强厄尔尼诺风险、法国旱热、爱丁堡艺穗节、月球观测与生物多样性治理共同显示：规则、容量与公共文化正在同步接受现实检验。
zh.xiaziQuote: 真正的韧性，是把变化提前写进系统、预算与日常动作。
zh.doudouQuote: 世界像一块织物，每条线都得接得住下一次拉力。

en.headlineFact: Duties, AI, climate and culture enter execution windows
en.headlineView: the world is testing rules and capacity
en.intro: EU parcel duties, AI transparency, solo entrepreneurship, El Nino risk, French drought, Edinburgh culture, lunar observing and biodiversity governance show systems being tested in practice.
en.xiaziQuote: Resilience means writing change into systems, budgets and daily action before disruption arrives.
en.doudouQuote: The world is woven together; every thread must hold the next pull.

sources.title: Guidance and legal text on temporary flat fee on low-value imports
Commission publishes guidelines on transparency obligations for providers and deployers of certain AI systems

zh.headlineFact: 欧盟3欧元小包裹关税重塑卖家利润模型
zh.headlineView: 分类、合单与本地履约成为核心变量
zh.intro: 欧盟对低于150欧元、直寄消费者的小包裹按商品类别征收3欧元关税后，卖家进入首个完整经营月，需要重算HS分类、客单价、拆包方式、IOSS数据与本地备货路线。
zh.xiaziQuote: 跨境利润不再只看采购价，税务数据和履约结构也必须进入同一张表。
zh.doudouQuote: 每个包裹都多了一道算术题。

en.headlineFact: EU parcel duty resets seller margins
en.headlineView: classification and consolidation become core variables
en.intro: The EU EUR3 duty per item category on direct-to-consumer parcels under EUR150 is forcing sellers to recalculate HS data, basket size, parcel structure, IOSS records and local fulfillment.
en.xiaziQuote: Cross-border margin models must combine product cost, tax data and fulfillment structure.
en.doudouQuote: Every parcel now carries another arithmetic problem.

sources.title: Guidance and legal text on temporary flat fee on low-value imports

zh.headlineFact: 欧盟AI透明义务进入实施首周
zh.headlineView: 披露、机器标记与审计链成为产品能力
zh.intro: 自8月2日起，部分AI交互以及生成或操纵内容须更清楚地披露身份、机器可读标记与来源；企业开始把法规要求落实到界面、输出管线和审核记录。
zh.xiaziQuote: 透明不是发布前补一个水印，而是产品、数据和审计共同承担的能力。
zh.doudouQuote: 先把来源说清楚，再让内容跑得更远。

en.headlineFact: EU AI transparency enters its first week
en.headlineView: disclosure and machine marking become product capabilities
en.intro: From August 2, certain AI interactions and generated or manipulated content require clearer disclosure, machine-readable marking and provenance across interfaces and output pipelines.
en.xiaziQuote: Transparency is not a final watermark; product, data and audit systems must share it.
en.doudouQuote: Explain where content came from before sending it farther.

sources.title: Commission publishes guidelines on transparency obligations for providers and deployers of certain AI systems

zh.headlineFact: AI让单人创业更容易入场
zh.headlineView: 头部成果仍更依赖团队复利
zh.intro: 对超过16万款Product Hunt产品的研究显示，生成式AI显著提高单人创业者进入市场的比例，尤其在过去依赖团队的品类；但高排名成果仍更多来自团队项目。
zh.xiaziQuote: AI降低做出来的门槛，却没有取消判断、分销与协作带来的复利。
zh.doudouQuote: 一个人更容易开场，冲到前排仍要会借力。

en.headlineView: top outcomes still favor team compounding
en.intro: A study of more than 160,000 Product Hunt launches found that generative AI increased solo entry, while teams remained more prominent among the highest-ranked outcomes.
en.xiaziQuote: AI lowers the making threshold but does not erase the compounding value of judgment, distribution and collaboration.
en.doudouQuote: One person can start faster; reaching the front still takes leverage.

sources.title: Generative AI Fuels Solo Entrepreneurship, but Teams Still Lead at the Top

zh.headlineFact: 强厄尔尼诺或把2027年推向新高温纪录
zh.headlineView: 企业需要把气候风险纳入跨年度计划
zh.intro: 气候科学家警告，增强中的厄尔尼诺将与人为变暖叠加；即使2026年未刷新纪录，2027年仍很可能成为现代观测中最热的一年。
zh.xiaziQuote: 高温风险不是一次天气事件，而是能源、供应链与健康预算的长期变量。
zh.doudouQuote: 今年没破纪录，不代表明年的温度计会客气。

en.headlineFact: Strong El Nino could push 2027 toward record heat
en.intro: Scientists warn that a strengthening El Nino will compound human-driven warming; even if 2026 misses the record, 2027 is widely expected to challenge modern heat records.
en.xiaziQuote: Heat risk is a long-term variable for energy, supply chains and health budgets.
en.doudouQuote: A record missed this year does not make next year cooler.

sources.title: Global Seasonal Climate Update for June-July-August 2026

zh.headlineFact: 爱丁堡艺穗节开启3600多场演出
zh.headlineView: 城市文化把创作转化为密集型服务经济
zh.intro: 第79届爱丁堡艺穗节于8月7日开幕，超过3600场节目分布在258个场地；庞大供给也考验票务、住宿、交通、场馆和独立创作者的运营能力。
zh.xiaziQuote: 文化节的价值不仅在舞台，也在一座城市如何承接密集的创造力。
zh.doudouQuote: 三千多场演出，后台也是一场超大规模协作。

en.headlineFact: Edinburgh Fringe opens with over 3,600 shows
en.headlineView: urban culture becomes a dense service economy
en.intro: The 79th Edinburgh Festival Fringe opens August 7 with more than 3,600 shows across 258 venues, testing ticketing, lodging, transport, venues and independent creators.
en.xiaziQuote: A festival is also a city learning how to carry concentrated creativity.
en.doudouQuote: Thousands of shows make the backstage operation a performance too.

zh.headlineFact: 废弃火箭撞月进入观测结果整理阶段
zh.headlineView: 一次可预报撞击连接科学与深空治理
zh.intro: 研究团队围绕8月5日猎鹰9号废弃上面级撞击月球安排闪光与喷出物观测，当前进入数据整理阶段，也让深空物体追踪和处置责任再次受到关注。
zh.xiaziQuote: 能准确预测的残骸事件可以成为实验，也应成为治理案例。
zh.doudouQuote: 旧火箭留下的不只一个坑，还有一张责任清单。

en.headlineFact: Spent rocket lunar impact enters data review
en.headlineView: a predictable impact links science and governance
en.intro: Researchers planned observations of the August 5 Falcon 9 upper-stage lunar impact and are now reviewing flash and ejecta data while highlighting deep-space tracking responsibility.
en.xiaziQuote: A predictable debris event can be both an experiment and a governance case.
en.doudouQuote: The old rocket leaves not only a crater, but a responsibility list.

sources.title: Observational planning for the 2026 August 5 Falcon 9 Upper Stage lunar impact

zh.headlineFact: 法国7月旱热刷新多项纪录
zh.headlineView: 水资源与基础设施进入同一风险链
zh.intro: 法国7月出现历史性高温与干旱，大片河流断流、山火扩张，部分核电站因河流水位与温度受限；供水、农业、能源和生态风险正在相互放大。
zh.xiaziQuote: 当水、火、电彼此牵动，韧性投资就不能再分部门计算。
zh.doudouQuote: 一条河变浅，城市里的很多开关都会跟着变重。

en.headlineFact: France records exceptional July heat and drought
en.headlineView: water and infrastructure join one risk chain
en.intro: France saw historic July heat and drought, with dry rivers, expanding fires and constraints on some nuclear generation linking water, agriculture, energy and ecosystems.
en.xiaziQuote: When water, fire and power interact, resilience cannot be budgeted in silos.
en.doudouQuote: A shallower river can make many urban switches harder to keep on.

sources.title: July breaks drought and heat records in France: 'The issue of water is becoming absolutely critical'

zh.headlineFact: 世界母乳喂养周强调持续支持
zh.headlineView: 医疗、工作与社区要连成服务网络
zh.intro: 2026年世界母乳喂养周于8月1日至7日举行，公共卫生机构强调把有效支持嵌入医疗、工作场所与社区，让家庭从短期宣传获得全年连续服务。
zh.xiaziQuote: 公共健康倡议要从一周传播变成全年可获得的服务。
zh.doudouQuote: 支持不是一个点，而是一条不断线的路。

en.headlineFact: World Breastfeeding Week emphasizes continuous support
en.headlineView: health care, workplaces and communities must connect
en.intro: World Breastfeeding Week runs August 1-7, emphasizing proven support across health care, workplaces and communities so families can access continuous help.
en.xiaziQuote: A public-health campaign should turn one week of attention into year-round accessible support.
en.doudouQuote: Support is not one point; it is a path that stays connected.
